The '''Court of Exile''' was a courthouse in [[Aygion Mountain]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. The Court's function was to try [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] that had been threatened with [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
